title: Leeman falls jumping a horse and plays with five broken ribs
summary: After a night of playing and partying, Leeman tries a show jump on a Mexican saddle, breaks five ribs and plays the rest of the engagement taped up.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong

blocks.x: In continuation of the other tape, possibly, he hired me as a chef in preference to my drumming! We were running out of steam the last few days. But we had so much in common that we damn near self-destructed. To conclude, with Ben Webster.

Midway in the engagement, our saddle sores healing, we got very daring in our riding. After a strenuous night of playing, then partying, and to the six o'clock redezvous at the stables, I decided to try jumping in a show at the park. The ring had a Cinderella foundation. Now if you know anything about jumping horses, you will know that you don't do it with a western form and a Mexican saddle.

So I lost my balance on a four ft. high hurdle, pulled on the horse's mouth, the horse responded beautifully, he stopped in mid air, but I didn't stop in mid-air, but continued on to the cinder bed. I was most fortunate -- just five broken ribs, three front and two back. So back to the hotel, X rays, and one of our doctor friends and an admirer of Ben's taped my rib cage from waist to armpits, and I played the rest of the engagement that way.

I couldn't bend to pick up a drop sticks, if any, and the management planted a waitress to keep an eye on the situation to pick up the sticks. I'd drop them only because of my unnatural position with all the tape around me and pain.
